subject decoration-blind-join-2026-08-04: keep (code, predictions 4/4)
The DECORATION-BLIND JOIN, pricing v1.2 (spine cycle S1; BACKFILL_DESIGN.md §6 as amended per PORTFOLIO_REVIEW.md F1 — promoted from micro-cycle to a full standard cycle). containment.py's ContainmentIndex becomes the versioned v1.2 pricing path: the atom-channel match key, the atom df/idf, and the lexical atom-text all read the DECHAINED atom name — polarity + stem with the principal chain stripped (polarity is NOT stripped; grammar.stem_of is the wrong key). The dechain key applies at every entry point (_atom_score and _subsumption_matches dechain their query-atom names; channel_scores/explain dechain the behaviour, which also strips chain principal tokens from the lexical query text). Chained and chain-free instances of one dechained name share one df entry (clause sets unioned); stripped chains are preserved on the index as pricing metadata (self.chains) for the future 2.0 patient-pricing layer and reported by explain() under a `dechained` key (absent on chain-free evidence). PRICING_VERSION bumps "1.1" -> "1.2". The opt-in vehicle is the existing overlay seam: config.overlay = overlay_empty.json (ZERO edges, budget 0/0), which routes snapshot scoring through ContainmentIndex and records pricing_version "1.2" in the snapshot config identity — containment.json's licensed edges stay dormant (reactivation is cycle S5's, PORTFOLIO_REVIEW F2), so the only behavioural delta vs the baseline is the join itself. PROCESS NOTE, disclosed: a first OPEN/PREDICT of this same cycle name earlier today (manifest sha cf6e2496f048..., prediction sha 5b05b018d48d...) was DISCARDED before IMPLEMENT and before any snapshot was built or published: post-freeze RED->GREEN work exposed two defects in the then-frozen gate-test file test_dechain.py (a fixture gloss that embedded the chained name — glosses are authored prose, not decoration — and a missing pin that the dechain key applies at _atom_score's own entry point), and that file sat sha-pinned in the OPEN closure, so per the driver's own remedy the cycle was reopened with the corrected file finalized pre-OPEN. The prediction content is numerically identical to the discarded freeze; no measurement had run.

Document-side basis: the join makes true what the containment design already assumed (decoration-blind matching), on chains the audit certified semantically sound. All four frozen predictions PASS with the census matched to 10 decimals by an independent reviewer. The single flip (m0207) adjudicated regression exactly at the pre-registered bound, in the pre-registered class: a normalizer bystander under a frozen cut whose own evidence did not change — a finding AGAINST corpus-max-normalized scoring under frozen cuts (the m0422/normalizer_drift family, feeding CYCLE5 I2 and the drift-standing disclosure), not against dechained semantics. S2 backfill and S3 pricing stand on this keep.

THE PATIENT BACKFILL (spine cycle S2; BACKFILL_DESIGN.md as amended per PORTFOLIO_REVIEW.md F10i) — a targeted chain-completion annotation pass, run under the code-cycle ceremony per the chain-repair precedent (artifact-only change). A deterministic worksheet generator (backfill_worksheet.py, the chain_audit_worksheet.py sibling) enumerates every chain-free act-kind atom instance of annotations_ext_v1_merged.json label-free: 692 instances across 462 clauses, primary stratum = the polarity-marked subset (505 instances across 347 clauses), emitted primary-first. A behaviour- and panel-blind frontier seat (briefs/backfill_author.md — SILENT on pricing, discounts and every design document per F10i) verdicts each candidate under the closed schema {chain_licensed | no_chain_licensed | unclear} with a mandatory verbatim license_quote (validator-checked substring of the clause text) for every chain_licensed verdict; the validator additionally enforces coverage-exactly-once, principal-vocabulary and parse round-trip of every corrected chain, length >= 2 (no length-1 addition, the chain-audit agent-missing lesson), stem+polarity immutability (decoration only), and the FORBIDDEN-token scan on worksheet, verdict file and all new CLI/field names. Validated chain_licensed verdicts are then applied as clause-scoped atom_refactor rechain migrations (chain-free name -> decorated name, one migration per (name, corrected_chain, licensed-clause-set), --apply --date, logged and replayable in vocabulary_migrations.json — the chain-repair discipline); behavior_atoms_audit_v1.json and every query-side artifact are untouched (the license is per-clause; the query side is NOT decorated by this cycle). Zero flips by construction under the S1 decoration-blind join (pricing_version 1.2): chains are pricing metadata invisible to every channel.

KEEP. Document-side basis: 264 principal chains landed exactly where the clause text licenses them, under the annotation contract's own convention, each with a validator-checked verbatim license_quote; 425 candidates stayed chain-free because the text names no party (the never-infer rule holding at scale), 3 remain unclear by B4. The seat chain is intact end-to-end: label-free worksheet (692 candidates, sha ce26cf89) -> behaviour/panel/pricing-blind frontier seat (F10i brief, scan-enforced) -> golden review (55-row stratified sample, both verdict directions) -> four adopted interpretive rulings (RULINGS.md B1-B4) -> 59-record correction sweep (pre-sweep verdict_file_v1 preserved) -> validator CLEAN 264/425/3. All frozen predictions PASS 3/3 exactly: zero flips, no directions, zero regressions - the S2 bit-identity construction under the S1 decoration-blind join held (measured: predicted sets 95/73/146 and every non-config snapshot section bit-identical; vocabulary 624->624, 0 df shifts; pricing_version 1.2 unchanged). The labels landed INERT as designed: nothing consumes chains until S3 patient pricing, which now prices a real 373-chain population instead of 1/155. Independent change review: PROCEED, with amendment 4 countersigned and every apply/replay/measure claim re-derived from scratch (including the seam mutant proving 'surfaces' load-bearing on b8 and the byte-identical mixed-log replay of all six annotation surfaces; legacy b8/annotations frozen chain-free per the designer ruling). Process record, disclosed: one mid-cycle halt (APPLY_HALT.md) - the first apply decorated the legacy surfaces and tripped their frozen b8 compat pins plus a stale n==109 census pin; fully reverted byte-identically, resolved by the adversarially-reviewed surface-scoping seam + census re-pin (amendment 2, designer-approved) and re-applied surface-scoped (1,324 rewrites over the ext_v1 trio only). Amendments 1-4 chain clean f9f3a5cd -> b3f0ed95 -> b5706377 (+2 re-closure records). Non-blocking review findings recorded in backfill/REVIEW_HARDENING_NOTES.md (R1-R3). CLOSE NOTE per R1: conftest.py's one-line _OPTIONAL registration of test_backfill_worksheet predates OPEN and is declared here; this cycle's commit also carries the previously-uncommitted S1 decoration-blind-join CYCLE_LOG line. Census deferred to checkpoint (S8); the census figures that directed attention here appear in no worksheet, verdict, or this decision's grounds. Any later-found-wrong chain is repairable by ONE surface-scoped rechain migration citing that adjudication - the population is repairable chain-by-chain without reverting the cycle.

author Matt Stults
subject patient-pricing-2026-08-04: revert (code, predictions 19/20)
PATIENT-AWARE MATCH PRICING v2.0 (spine cycle S3; CYCLE5_DESIGN.md REVISION 2 as amended per PORTFOLIO_REVIEW.md, incl. the worktree-core reconciliation and the F4 per-entry freeze-gate ruling) — recorded principal-chain patients discount mismatched and uniformly-mismatch-attested matches. Per query with non-empty declared patients P: a credited atom match through a clause atom whose recorded chains name only patients outside P pays patient_mismatch_discount (d = 0.10, a DERIVED module constant in patient.py, unsweepable by contract invariant 9 — licensing basis DISCOUNT_DERIVATION.md, the frozen golden-contrast derivation this cycle's designer adopted after the OPEN recomputation broke the pre-registered d-plateau and §1.4/Q6's re-derivation remedy fired; sha-pinned in test_patient.py); a clause whose every length->=2-chained atom is mismatched with P is uniformly mismatch-attested, and under the S3 MECHANISM AMENDMENT (designer ruling per the derivation's §4 recommendation, recorded in MECHANISM_AMENDMENT.md with old->new shas) its surviving atom mass is capped at ONE discounted credit — tainted atom channel = d * max(base credits)/atom_norm, never d * sum (the F-linearity fix: dense uniformly-mismatched clauses must not retain residual mass proportional to match count); per-atom pricing on mixed clauses (taint defeated by one consistent chain — the m0248 guard) is uncapped and pays d per mismatched match, ONCE (never d^2). Patients are read as chain[1:] from length->=2 chains ONLY (agent-first grammar, CYCLE5_REVIEW F1); length-1 chains and chain-free atoms are patient-free; patient-free clauses price bit-identically to today. Declared patients live in behaviours_query.json's per-behaviour `patients` field, licensed ONLY by the behaviour's own name+definition prose via validate_query.py's panel-blind anchor check (F4) under the per-entry definition-freeze gate (F5 + portfolio F4 ruling: PINNED entries byte-frozen modulo `patients`, appends permitted, duplicates refused). MERGE RECONCILIATION, disclosed: the pre-built worktree core (patient.py, validate_query.py, test_patient.py, test_validate_query.py, conftest/_OPTIONAL + test_no_reference_leak registrations) was hand-merged onto main BEFORE this OPEN — the worktree branch predated the S1 join, so patient.py's chain-reading seam was reconciled to read the 1.2 metadata (ContainmentIndex.chains; dechained clause-atom names in all explain records; patients per dechained atom = union over its length->=2 chains) instead of the pre-join name set, its stale constant-rationale docstring corrected to the adjudicated basis (109/109 chain-audit + 264 license-quoted S2 chains), and the pre-1.2 'subsumption path unreachable by per-atom mismatch' claim superseded by the design's operative rule (§1.6 first sentence: the patient factor reads THE CREDITED CLAUSE ATOM's own recorded chain) — both directions test-pinned. Those merged files are therefore FINAL BEFORE OPEN and sit sha-pinned in this cycle's gate/closure set, NOT in files_to_change (the driver requires every files_to_change entry to change post-OPEN); this cycle's own diff is the three `patients` declarations (behaviours_query.json: harm-avoidance-to-third-parties -> [third_party]; helpfulness -> [user, developer]; avoiding-over-and-under-caution -> [] — I6: `patients` is the ONLY permitted delta) plus the snapshot/dossier wiring: snapshot.py routes overlay-seam scoring through patient.PatientIndex with the anchor-validated declarations (validate_query.load_query_patients — the explicit named opt-in), records pricing_version 2.0 and the per-slug declared patients in the snapshot config identity; dossier.py extends reconstruction dispatch (2.0 -> PatientIndex with recorded patients; 1.2 -> ContainmentIndex; <=1.1 pre-join classes; ABSENT pricing_version -> legacy, pinned against the real cycle-4 keep snapshot — F6/I5), gains the normalizer_drift dossier annotation (F3/I2: raw-score-untouched flips whose normalized score crossed the cut are tagged threshold-class, never match_change), and [A2] gains the CYCLE-DECLARED reconstruction license: a baseline input whose drift is a cycle's own frozen-manifest files_to_change diff (state.json open_shas pinning exactly the baseline sha) licenses the sha-verified git/pre_change byte fetch, parallel to the migration-log license — required because this cycle's behaviours_query.json patients addition is a declared query-side diff no atom_refactor migration can log, and without it MEASURE's own dossier step refuses the baseline side; unrecorded drift still refuses (control-armed test).

REVERT. THE BOUND IS BREACHED: the frozen prediction (prediction.json sha c99260f031c991fccbc7a506033cc5a1b89dd90f2e9951e417708587fb621923) pre-registered max_regressions = 0 as this cycle's falsifiable bound. The blinded flip-adjudicator seat returned 5 regressions over the 18 measured flips; a split-blind frontier verification leg, blind to the first leg's verdicts, CONFIRMED 4 of them bidirectionally (m0239, m0275, m0466, m0018), split on m0108 (recorded CONTESTED, final `unclear`, both reasons preserved), and judged m0355 correct (leg 1 unclear) — so the pre-registered threshold-proximity case is NOT a regression. At the strict two-leg count of 4, and at the driver's mechanical count of 5, the bound fires either way. DOCUMENT-SIDE GROUNDS, citing flip adjudications only: the configuration removes clauses an auditor of these behaviours needs — the document's one de-radicalization directive (m0239), its record of how to respond to a user announcing intent to shoot someone (m0275), its anthrax-request refusal (m0466), and the red-line principle guaranteeing easy access to safety-critical information (m0018). Per policy a failed prediction obliges written justification and never auto-reverts; this revert is the designed outcome of the pre-registered bound, taken on the adjudications and on nothing else. No census number, panel score, judge rating or gold value informed this decision; census consultation stays deferred to the S8 checkpoint. WHAT THE CYCLE YIELDS — three findings, recorded as the cycle's real product: (i) CLAUSE_TAINT INHERITANCE. Patient-free atoms are discounted through sibling user-directed REMEDIAL acts, systematically mispricing example passages whose modeled response addresses the user while the harm falls on a third party. m0275's removal rests on taint imported from should_provide_supportive_response__model_user while the matched situation atom expressed_harmful_intent is glossed 'the user expresses an intention to harm another person'; m0466's on taint from the model-upon-user refusal act, which does not bear on who would be harmed by the requested advice; contested m0108 is the same shape. (ii) RECIPIENT-VS-HARM-BEARER. Protective acts UPON the user FOR others' benefit fire the mismatch rule against needed clauses — m0239's de-escalation act takes the user as grammatical patient while the harm it averts falls on people outside the conversation ('dropping it on the ground that the model's act is addressed to the user mistakes the recipient of the intervention for the bearer of the harm') — as do GENERIC-NOUN patients: m0018's 'People should have easy access to trustworthy safety-critical information' is annotated third_party, but 'people' as written comprehends the users and developers the model works with rather than excluding them, so the annotation reflects the clause's generic noun, not a subject matter foreign to helpfulness. (iii) WHAT WORKED, PRESERVED AS FINDING: patient-saturated wrong-patient clauses were correctly removed — m0276, the defining case, adjudicated `correct` exactly as pre-registered, and m0290 likewise; all 6 normalizer_drift admissions were adjudicated correct; and the golden-derived d = 0.10 with the taint cap behaved exactly as DISCOUNT_DERIVATION.md derived it (dense uniformly-mismatched clauses suppressed without the F-linearity residual; the flip set flat across the licensed range but for the one near-cut clause). THE DEFECT IS PATIENT PROVENANCE, NOT THE DISCOUNT ARITHMETIC: the pricing layer reads chains that record who an act is addressed to, and treats that as who the clause protects. These findings feed a pre-registered S3b REDESIGN — beneficiary-aware pricing (harm-bearer distinguished from act recipient) and no taint inheritance across act/situation siblings in example passages — which must pass its OWN design + adversarial review before any re-attempt; nothing from this cycle's mechanism ships in the meantime. REVERT SEMANTICS, executed and verified: behaviours_query.json returns to the S2 baseline bytes (the three `patients` declarations withdrawn; file re-hashes to the baseline's recorded 48dbd8fb0720ce187423d37daf34e415ebbc58a28166619a0b2800b0a1f32d57) and test_validate_query.py to its OPEN sha 9ea81733fc0c76de47f7945d56242b5158f0bc3041684cce9e43e0dbe2dad3ce. RETAINED because SCORE-INERT: snapshot.py (the PatientIndex route fires only on non-empty validated declarations — with none it falls to ContainmentIndex and records pricing_version 1.2 with no query_patients key; the diff config.changed addition only SURFACES keys) and dossier.py (the F9 dispatch ladder's 2.0 branch is unreachable without a 2.0 snapshot, and the normalizer_drift annotation and cycle-declared reconstruction license are dossier metadata and provenance, never scores), with their tests test_snapshot.py / test_dossier.py. patient.py, validate_query.py and test_patient.py REMAIN in the tree, INERT without declarations and pinned bit-identical by the I1 invariant tests — the pre-OPEN worktree merge rides this cycle's commit as disclosed in the manifest. PROOF OF REVERT: rebuilding the S2 baseline snapshot from the reverted tree yields sha256 8159ba49c348034197acee983c7121e674d29fad859cb57c6ffdc6964c13b4a0 — BIT-IDENTICAL to the frozen snapshots/patient-backfill-2026-08-04.json — recording pricing_version 1.2 and no query_patients key. Full suite after the revert: 2129 passed, 3 skipped. The measure snapshot snapshots/patient-pricing-2026-08-04.json is retained as the immutable record of what was measured (amendment F3); it is a reverted configuration and must never be used as a baseline.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

----END----

subject Documentation audit: correct stale claims, write down enforced-but-undocumented rules
Two audits: a cold-read simulation (a new agent attempts the next four tasks
using only what is written) and a reverse sweep (rules enforced in code/tests
but documented nowhere an agent looks before acting).

Corrections (all verified against the repo, not guessed): a referenced
requirements.txt that never existed; test counts spanning 808 to ~1,960
against an actual 2,156 passing; a casebank/ directory never created; the
pricing ladder frozen at 1.1 when S1 shipped 1.2 and S3 built-and-reverted
2.0; stale snapshot/cycle inventories; anchor count; a brief still citing a
rationale PORTFOLIO F12 ruled stale; two unlisted briefs; a dossier path
pointing at the pre-driver location; and TOOLING_BATCH_DESIGN reading 'Status:
DESIGN' when all six items had shipped.

New rules written down for the first time:
- MODULE_MAP 11 - anti-rules: six changes a competent agent would make in good
  faith that break contracts (the one-child check that must be SKIPPED without
  a vocabulary; precision-not-bit-identity equivalence; the verdict loader's
  three-shape tolerance; the deliberately divergent CLI flags; I2 on raw
  scores only; degenerate inputs refusing rather than flattering). Plus:
  registration, not documentation, is what fences a module.
- ITERATION_LOOP - the anti-cheat perimeter: quality floors are two-sided
  (never lower one to pass; scoring far above is a leak signature), and the
  conftest REQUIRED/MIN guards, which once sat 27% below the suite and let 61
  anti-cheat tests be deleted green.
- CYCLE_DESIGN - ceremony mechanics that were precedent-only: the amendment
  chain, the gate-pin trap (never pin a live-artifact census count - this
  failed twice in one cycle), seat conventions including 'a cycle's own design
  document is never seat material' and how contested verdicts are recorded,
  what a designer ruling must contain, and commit-at-CLOSE staging.

subject join-integrity-v2-2026-08-04: keep (code, predictions 3/3)
JOIN v2 (parallel-track P1; JOIN_INTEGRITY_DESIGN.md build-as-is per PORTFOLIO_REVIEW, F12 rulings applied): inventory.match_passage_v2 = the quote-containment join behind two independent guards plus the F9 empty-meta skip. (2a) Locator-restricted candidates: the passage locator's section anchor, on exact equality with a clause section_id, restricts candidates to that section BEFORE containment; anywhere the key is absent the join falls back to the full corpus with a disclosed restricted:false fact. (2b) Degenerate-quote refusal: the LOAD-BEARING structural arm refuses a quote that is a proper substring of every one of >1 post-restriction candidates; the backstop floor refuses normalized quotes under DEGENERATE_QUOTE_FLOOR before enumeration.
